description: Every file outside server/services/run/ that runs the agent loop (agentLoop.run), builds one (new AgentLoop) or calls a tool past the tool runner (runTool), with the rules it may break, the reason and the issue that removes it. server/tests/architecture/runCallers.test.js fails for a file that is not listed and for a listed rule the file no longer breaks.

entries.reason: Frozen legacy workflow executor: a legacy prompt node runs its own agent loop (built per executor) and executeToolCall runs its tools (sha256 in workflow-legacy-frozen.test.js). Legacy workflow runs get none of the run service's or the tool runner's guarantees in the first release.
Frozen legacy workflow executor: a legacy tool node runs the tool the workflow author chose, not one a model picked (sha256 in workflow-legacy-frozen.test.js).
